purpose: Separate the agent and MCP transport from the operating-system driver.

semantics.coordinates: Full physical display pixels; image dimensions may differ. A desktop viewer needs a separate coordinate transform.
semantics.snapshot: Required, short-lived window/package/geometry guard. Content changes within the same window require semantic target guards or fresh observations.
semantics.requested: Owning system/app was asked; completion is not established.
semantics.dispatched: Input was accepted/completed; task outcome is not established.
semantics.unknown_result: An action may have happened; never replay automatically.
semantics.unsupported: Report lack of the capability; do not invent successful fallback.
